- Content creators wanting to repurpose clips
- Users building personal collections
- Anyone sharing content across platforms

## Vidify's Solution

Our AI-powered downloader extracts the original video file without any watermarks, giving you clean, high-quality content.

### How It Works

2. **Copy the Link**: Tap the share button and select "Copy Link"
3. **Paste in Vidify**: Our tool automatically removes watermarks
4. **Download**: Get your clean video in seconds
